title: Travel day: easy 30 flat, first flat running since 22 Aug
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 30min conversational, flat, whenever it fits around the flight. Cadence 165-170 spm from the first minute, metronome on: shorter steps at the same effort, not more pace. Step width slightly wider than feels natural.
GYM: none today, the hip block was yesterday.
FUEL: nothing needed under an hour.
STOP RULE: no symptoms during, after, or next day. Lateral knee pain that appears during and worsens as it goes means walk the rest and tell me. Tenderness to touch at the shockwave site is expected.
WHY IT MATTERS: first flat running since 22 Aug, and flat is the gradient band the ITB actually cares about. Do not extend past 30min because it feels good, the analgesic window is still open.
